611:t_001:20.en:
$n
「...Isn't that still quite a way off...?」

611:t_001:21.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't you think you can do it?」

611:t_001:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then let's give it our best. I'm counting on you, $n.」

611:t_001:25.en:
$$さやか$$
「Those two look a little suspicious...」

611:t_001:26.en:
$$甲児$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ came back with a new ability: taking the initiative.」

611:t_001:29.en:
$$カレン$$
「It looks like we need to finish this fight fast and get the whole story.」

611:t_001:30.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then we can't afford to lose this battle.」

611:t_001:31.en:
$$赤木$$
「Of course, we never planned to lose in the first place!」

611:t_001:32.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「At last... our decisive battle with the Empire is beginning.」

611:t_001:33.en:
$$ノノ$$
「We're definitely winning this first round by knockout!」

611:t_001:34.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「We're definitely winning this first round by knockout!」

611:t_001:35.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「We're definitely winning this first round by knockout!」

611:t_001:36.en:
$$タケル$$
「For everyone fighting all over the world!」

611:t_001:37.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And for everyone waiting for us to come home!」

611:t_001:39.en:
$n
(I won't think about anything else now...! I'll focus on what's right in front of me!)

611:t_001:40.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, commence attack! We'll seize $$セントラル・ベース$$ and make it our bridgehead for the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

611:t_001:43.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My apologies, but I'll be crushing humanity's hopes here.」

611:t_003:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Is that one of the Empire's $$リアクター|lc$$s?!」

611:t_003:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You came out because you can't leave this to your three deputies?!」

611:t_003:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Someone who can't trust their subordinates has no business leading people!」

611:t_003:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「We came to prepare the finest possible stage for you.」

611:t_003:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Well then, let's get started!」

611:t_004:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「What are you planning to do?!」

611:t_004:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I will establish a domain here.」

611:t_004:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セントラル・ベース$$ is a device for extracting this planet's $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

611:t_004:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「We'll control it with our $$スフィア$$s and create the ultimate battlefield!」

611:t_005:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Is that a $$時空震動$$...?! No, that's not it!」

611:t_005:1.en:
$$號$$
「They're... going to distort the laws of causality in this space!」

611:t_005:2.en:
$n
「What the hell is going to happen?!」

611:t_006:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「What the hell! I thought we'd get blasted all the way to the center of the galaxy again, but nothing happened!」

611:t_007:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「My body... I can't put any strength into it...!」

611:t_007:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The situation cannot be analyzed. An effect has occurred without a cause.」

611:t_007:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「We rewrite the laws within a limited space...」

611:t_007:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The dimensional cage is an expanded version of this.」

611:t_007:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You can probably only manage about 50% of your normal strength now.」

611:t_007:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry. I don't really like using tricks like this.」

611:t_007:9.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You have touched upon the forbidden.」

611:t_007:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's right. Humans aren't supposed to know about it.」

611:t_007:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Why have you kept your control over humanity a secret?」

611:t_007:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you only wanted to halt humanity's evolution, ruling through overwhelming force should have been enough!」

611:t_007:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Everyone has their real motives and their public excuses. Whatever position they're in.」

611:t_007:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You have no need to know that.」

611:t_007:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Too bad, $$アムブリエル$$. If you'd obtained the $$いがみ合う双子$$, you might have learned what lies beyond.」

611:t_007:19.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I'll leave the rest to you, $$尸刻$$.」

611:t_007:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「$$バルビエル$$, do you have no words of encouragement for me?」

611:t_007:25.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You might not like it, but I'm counting on you, $$ダバラーン$$. $$アウストラリス$$ is pretty serious about this, too.」

611:t_007:26.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Understood. I know that victory is our paramount order.」

611:t_007:27.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Heh... I love you, $$ダバラーン$$.」

611:t_008:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You did it, General $$ダバラーン$$! What a truly miraculous victory!」

611:t_008:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Allow me to offer my congratulations.」

611:t_008:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Thank you, $$サルディアス$$, $$尸刻$$! We shall win this battle without fail!」

611:t_008:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Damn it...! They're getting all worked up on their own!」

611:t_008:6.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Can't you do something, $$クロウ$$?!」

611:t_008:7.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You've got $$スフィア$$s too! Can't you break this rigged space?!」
